title: Relational Resonance and Content Creation
near_miss_reason: Staggered binary design (responsive tie RT switches on at initiator-specific weeks: 814 treated initiators across 53 adoption weeks, 814 rolling-entry-matched never-responded controls, 54 weeks, no switch-offs), but every main-text column is a Bayesian hierarchical model with random (not fixed) initiator intercepts and random RT slopes, 14 lagged time-varying controls, and control-function residuals (gr.RT, gr.Upload) as extra regressors; the Volume model is Poisson. The Figure 7 relative-time model drops initiator effects entirely and keeps the controls and correction terms. Several violations, so not a 5c controls-only case.

ineligible_specs.exclusion_reason: random initiator intercepts and RT slopes (Bayesian MCMC) instead of unit FE; time-varying lagged controls; selection-correction residuals gr.RT and gr.Upload
Poisson hierarchical model plus the violations of T4_c1
model-fit comparison of nested random-effects specifications; no treatment estimates
same hierarchical model on CEM and alternative matched samples
RT x continuous moderator; number of ties (continuous)
no initiator FE (pooled model), time-varying controls and correction terms; leads/lags de-trended

eligible_reason: No qualifying column. Design is staggered (RT turns on at 53 different weeks with never-responded matched controls), but all estimates come from a Bayesian hierarchical random-coefficient model (main_code.R, MCMC) with time-varying controls and control-function residuals; the volume equation is Poisson. Random effects in place of unit FE are not eligible (5b).
design_notes: Main_data.dta: 1,628 initiators x weeks 1-54 (65,541 rows; 45,068 with engagement outcomes), RT absorbing, 814 ever-treated, first RT weeks 2-54. Model (Section 4.2): LikesRatio/dSubsRatio = alpha_i + beta_i RT_{i,t-1} + gamma X_{i,t-1} + gr terms + week FE, with alpha_i, beta_i random. Matching by rolling entry matching (REM.dta). Table 4 RT: 0.011 (LikesRatio), 0.029 (dSubsRatio), -0.277 (Volume).
estimators_reported: bayesian_hierarchical_random_coefficients (MCMC) with controls and control functions
